title: Animals And Birds Their State Of Invocation And The Introduction To 3 Truths

questions.question: What new part of creation opened to the traveler in this passage?
questions.answer: The world of animals and birds opened to him.

questions.question: How was the traveler invited into that realm?
questions.answer: He was called in by many different voices and ways of speaking.

questions.question: What message were the animals and birds showing again and again?
questions.answer: They were showing that Allah is One.

questions.question: How did their voices affect the picture of the earth?
questions.answer: They made the earth seem like a huge place of worship and praise.

questions.question: What does the passage compare each animal and bird to?
questions.answer: Each one is like a poem, a word, or a sign pointing to Allah’s mercy and greatness.

questions.question: What is said about the body parts and abilities of animals and birds?
questions.answer: They are described as orderly and balanced, like meaningful words.

questions.question: How many big truths did the traveler notice in this realm?
questions.answer: He noticed three great and wide-reaching truths.

questions.question: What is the first truth mainly about?
questions.answer: It is about animals being made with wisdom, purpose, and careful design, not by accident.

questions.question: According to the first truth, what things are rejected as the cause of life?
questions.answer: Chance, blind force, and lifeless nature are rejected.

questions.question: What does the giving of life to animals show?
questions.answer: It shows knowledge, wisdom, and will.

questions.question: What does the first truth bear witness to about Allah?
questions.answer: It points to Allah’s necessary existence, His perfect qualities, and His oneness.

questions.question: What is the second truth mainly about?
questions.answer: It is about the special differences, beauty, and balanced forms of living creatures.

questions.question: Why does the passage say only Allah could do this work?
questions.answer: Because making so many different creatures with wisdom and beauty is too great for anyone else.

questions.question: As the traveler continued thinking deeply, what happened before him?
questions.answer: A door opened to the animal and bird world.

questions.question: What had the traveler already gathered on his journey?
questions.answer: He had gained more eagerness, understanding, and faith.

questions.question: In what two ways were animals and birds declaring the truth?
questions.answer: They were declaring it both without words and with sounds.

questions.question: What truth were they declaring?
questions.answer: They were declaring that only Allah is worthy of worship.

questions.question: What did the earth become because of their praise?
questions.answer: It became like a giant gathering place for remembering and glorifying Allah.

questions.question: How does the passage describe every animal as a sign?
questions.answer: Each one is shown as something that points to Allah’s mercy and praises Him.

questions.question: What does it mean that their senses and limbs are like expressions?
questions.answer: It means their bodies are arranged so carefully that they show meaning and wisdom.

questions.question: What is the first proof the traveler saw in animals?
questions.answer: He saw that they are made on purpose and with skill.

questions.question: Why can their creation not be explained by luck or lifeless matter?
questions.answer: Because their life and design are full of order, meaning, and wisdom.

questions.question: What three qualities are especially seen in their being given life?
questions.answer: Knowledge, wisdom, and will are especially seen.

questions.question: What is the second proof the traveler saw?
questions.answer: He saw the amazing variety, beauty, and balance among creatures.

questions.question: Which details in creatures support the second proof?
questions.answer: Their different features, decorated looks, measured sizes, and organized forms support it.

questions.question: What does the passage say is impossible for anyone besides Allah?
questions.answer: It is impossible for anyone besides Allah to make and manage such complete and wonderful variety.

questions.question: Who is the main person observing the animal world in this passage?
questions.answer: It is the traveler who is reflecting on creation.

questions.question: What kind of realm did he enter?
questions.answer: He entered the realm of animals and birds.

questions.question: What showed that this realm was full of many kinds of creatures?
questions.answer: The many different voices and forms of expression showed that.

questions.question: What were all these creatures united in announcing?
questions.answer: They were united in announcing Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: What larger picture did the traveler see when he looked at all of them together?
questions.answer: He saw the whole earth as if it were full of praise and remembrance of Allah.

questions.question: Besides making sounds, how else do animals point to Allah?
questions.answer: Their very bodies, abilities, and movements point to Him.

questions.question: Why are animals compared to meaningful words and lines of praise?
questions.answer: Because their order and design act like messages about their Creator.

questions.question: What does the first truth teach about how animals came to be?
questions.answer: It teaches that they were created intentionally and wisely.

questions.question: What false explanations are pushed aside in the first truth?
questions.answer: Random chance, blind power, and dead nature are pushed aside.

questions.question: What repeated witness comes from all living creatures in the first truth?
questions.answer: Their existence keeps pointing again and again to Allah’s living power and oneness.

questions.question: What does the second truth focus on in the animal world?
questions.answer: It focuses on their differences, beauty, proportion, and neat arrangement.

questions.question: How do these differences help prove a Creator?
questions.answer: They show careful choice and control, not confusion or accident.

questions.question: What can we infer from the phrase that no one else can claim this work?
questions.answer: We can infer that creation belongs only to Allah.

questions.question: What opened to the traveler’s mind as he moved forward in reflection?
questions.answer: The entrance to the world of animals and birds opened to him.

questions.question: What does the passage show about the number of sounds in that world?
questions.answer: It shows that there were countless sounds and ways of expression.

questions.question: What shared act were all the species, groups, and kinds doing?
questions.answer: They were all declaring Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the earth after this declaration?
questions.answer: It is described like a huge place filled with glorification and prayer.

questions.question: In what way is every animal like a sign from Allah?
questions.answer: Every animal points to His mercy and gives praise and thanks.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the order of their parts and abilities?
questions.answer: Their parts and abilities are arranged in a balanced and disciplined way.

questions.question: What did the traveler understand from this order?
questions.answer: He understood that animals thank their Creator and witness to His unity.

questions.question: What is important about the words “with wisdom and purpose” in the first truth?
questions.answer: They show that animals were made intentionally, not meaninglessly.

questions.question: Why is blind force not enough to explain living creatures?
questions.answer: Because living creatures show knowledge, choice, and careful design.

questions.question: What does the first truth say about life itself?
questions.answer: It says life is given in a way that clearly shows wisdom, knowledge, and will.

questions.question: What makes the second truth “vast and powerful”?
questions.answer: It includes endless kinds of creatures, each with its own beauty and balanced form.

questions.question: Which features of animals are mentioned in the second truth?
questions.answer: Their different marks, decorated looks, measured bodies, and well-arranged forms are mentioned.

questions.question: What conclusion does the second truth lead to about the Creator?
questions.answer: The Creator must have complete power and complete knowledge.

questions.question: What did the traveler enter after gaining more understanding and faith?
questions.answer: He entered the realm of animals and birds.

questions.question: What do the many voices in the passage suggest about creation?
questions.answer: They suggest that many kinds of creatures are all praising Allah in their own ways.

questions.question: What sentence gives the main message of the creatures?
questions.answer: Their main message is that Allah alone is the true God.

questions.question: How is the whole earth pictured because of the creatures’ praise?
questions.answer: It is pictured as a giant place of worship and glorification.

questions.question: What three things is each creature compared to in meaning?
questions.answer: Each one is like a song of praise, a statement of glory, and a sign of mercy.

questions.question: What do animals do besides simply existing?
questions.answer: They describe their Maker and give thanks to Him.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention senses, powers, limbs, and tools of the body?
questions.answer: To show that every part of an animal is meaningful and carefully arranged.

questions.question: What is the first major truth the traveler saw?
questions.answer: He saw that living creatures are created skillfully and on purpose.

questions.question: What qualities are shown many times in the giving of life?
questions.answer: Knowledge, wisdom, and will are shown many times.

questions.question: What is the second major truth the traveler saw?
questions.answer: He saw the special variety and beauty among creatures.

questions.question: How do decoration and proportion help the traveler reach his conclusion?
questions.answer: They show careful planning and wise design.

questions.question: Why does the passage stress that no one else could claim this act?
questions.answer: To make clear that such complete creation belongs only to Allah.

questions.question: What world did the traveler’s understanding enter in this part of the text?
questions.answer: His understanding entered the world of animals and birds.

questions.question: What shows that the invitation into this world was wide and rich?
questions.answer: The invitation came through very many voices and forms of expression.

questions.question: What were all the creatures saying through their condition and sounds?
questions.answer: They were saying that there is only one true God, Allah.

questions.question: What does the passage mean by saying the earth became a huge assembly?
questions.answer: It means the whole earth seemed filled with creatures praising Allah together.

questions.question: How is each animal or bird meaningful even without human speech?
questions.answer: Its design and life still act like a message about Allah.

questions.question: What does each creature reveal about Allah besides His greatness?
questions.answer: Each creature also points to His mercy.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about the structure of animal bodies?
questions.answer: It teaches that their bodies and abilities are ordered, balanced, and purposeful.

questions.question: What idea is at the center of the first truth?
questions.answer: The center is that animals are created intentionally with wisdom and skill.

questions.question: What does the passage say cannot be the real maker of animals?
questions.answer: It says chance, blind force, and lifeless nature cannot be the real maker.

questions.question: What does the animation of creatures show clearly?
questions.answer: It shows knowledge, wisdom, and will.

questions.question: What is the center of the second truth?
questions.answer: The center is the amazing variety and beauty among living creatures.

questions.question: Which examples from the passage support this second truth?
questions.answer: Their different features, decorated appearances, balanced sizes, and organized forms support it.

questions.question: What do these two truths together help prove?
questions.answer: They help prove Allah’s existence, power, knowledge, and oneness.
